findings.title: Intermittent TCP partial-read test flake in clio-ops MockEmbed test double
findings.evidence: crates/clio-ops/src/reindex_space_tests.rs:90,143-149: let n = stream.read(&mut buf).unwrap_or(0); let request = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]); parses request_input_count on a single TCP read without waiting for HTTP headers or Content-Length body completion, falling back to 1 on two-item batches (AmError { code: OutOfRange, message: "embed response count 1 does not match batch size 2" }).
findings.recommendation: Buffer incoming TCP stream bytes until \r\n\r\n and the declared Content-Length body bytes are fully received before parsing the JSON body in MockEmbed.
findings.resolution: Fixed in crates/clio-ops/src/reindex_space_tests.rs. Added `read_http_request`, which loops on the socket until it has the `\r\n\r\n` header terminator plus the declared `Content-Length` body (helper `content_length`), then MockEmbed counts the batch from the complete request. Reproduced before the fix: 38/600 parallel runs of `reindex_space_tests::reindex_across_two_providers_and_widths` failed with `reindex succeeds: AmError { code: OutOfRange, message: "embed response count 1 does not match batch size 2" }` (panic at reindex_space_tests.rs:181). After the fix: 0/600 parallel runs failed. `make check` exited 0; `make coverage` reported 317 files, TOTAL lines 97.97% / functions 98.89%, all per-file floors met. File is 241 lines.

findings.title: Stdio store-retrieve test relies on test-only in-memory BufRead interceptor rather than background sweeper or subprocess
findings.evidence: crates/clio-mcp/src/stdio_tests.rs:29-82: DrainBeforeRetrieve implements BufRead to trigger state.drain_index() between store and retrieve frames to avoid sweeper timing dependencies, rather than testing the real background sweeper or subprocess execution (am mcp stdio).
findings.recommendation: Complement the in-memory stdio::serve unit test with an integration-level subprocess test invoking am mcp stdio to test the full runtime binary and background sweeper thread across real OS pipes.
findings.resolution: Added crates/clio-lib/tests/stdio_subprocess_test.rs. It launches the compiled `clio mcp stdio` binary over OS pipes, sends a grounded `store` frame, polls `maintenance_status` over the same pipes until the real background sweeper reports `pending_jobs=0` and `lexical_rows=1`, then sends `retrieve` and asserts the stored id is returned. Closing stdin must yield a clean exit. Evidence: `cargo test --locked -p clio --test stdio_subprocess_test` -> 1 passed; 20/20 repeated runs with `DATABASE_URL` set -> 0 failures; `make check` exit 0. Location note: the test lives in `crates/clio-lib/tests/` rather than `crates/clio-mcp/tests/` because the `clio` binary and `CARGO_BIN_EXE_clio` belong to the `clio` package, and adding `clio` as a dev-dependency of `clio-mcp` would create a dependency cycle (`clio` already depends on `clio-mcp`). The existing in-memory stdio test is retained for deterministic framing/stdout-purity coverage.

plan_1hr: Harden crates/clio-ops/src/reindex_space_tests.rs::MockEmbed to loop-read until the full HTTP request body is assembled before parsing request_input_count, eliminating the intermittent test flake during parallel workspace test runs.
plan_unlimited: Implement a true subprocess test (am mcp stdio) in crates/clio-mcp/tests/ to exercise the full binary entry point and background sweeper lifecycle over an OS pipe, complementing the in-process stdio::serve unit test.
Consider adding an MCP schema draft for raw conversation ingestion if external non-native callers demonstrate a need for unchunked turn extraction over MCP.

remediation.summary: Both findings resolved. F-01's partial-read flake is closed with a before/after parallel reproduction (38/600 failing before, 0/600 after). F-02 is addressed with a real subprocess test of `clio mcp stdio` that exercises the background sweeper over OS pipes; the in-memory test is kept. `make check` exited 0 and the single final `make coverage` gate passed (317 files, TOTAL lines 97.97% / functions 98.89%, all per-file floors met).

plan_1hr.evidence: Same fix and before/after evidence as F-01 (crates/clio-ops/src/reindex_space_tests.rs; 38/600 failures before, 0/600 after).

plan_unlimited.evidence: Implemented by the F-02 subprocess test in crates/clio-lib/tests/stdio_subprocess_test.rs (the `clio-mcp/tests/` path is not reachable without a dependency cycle; see F-02 resolution). 20/20 repeated runs passed.

The condition (external non-native callers demonstrating a need for unchunked turn extraction over MCP) does not hold: native callers use `clio_write::ingest_raw` and MCP callers use the existing `store` binding. No schema draft was added, and no acceptance criterion depends on one. The revisit condition is now explicit in crates/clio-mcp/README.md (Raw-ingest binding decision).
